product_family: AI-powered automated audio post-production platform for podcasts, education, video, audiobooks, and broadcast. Includes web UI, API, CLI, and white-label integrations.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Auphonic is compliant with the General Data Protection Regulation of the European Union and applies this standard to all customers worldwide, not just EU customers.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type 1 certification found on vendor domain or security documentation.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 Type 2 certification found on vendor domain or security documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found on vendor domain or security documentation.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of HIPAA certification or compliance. Service terms make clear this is not a healthcare-specific product.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification found on vendor domain or security documentation.

certifications.name: Data Processing Agreement
certifications.proof_quote: Auphonic provides Data Processing Agreements to paying customers who process personal data of third parties on request.

privacy.ai_training_note: Auphonic uses selected customer audio/video content to improve its algorithms. Employees may access and listen to content for algorithm development and improvement purposes. No opt-out mechanism mentioned in policy.
privacy.data_region: Germany (Hetzner primary, Cloudflare R2 secondary). EU users get EU-restricted or Germany storage; non-EU users stored in EU or near-location buckets.

security.name: Data Storage Location
security.value: Primary: Germany (Hetzner). Secondary: Cloudflare R2 (EU-restricted for EU users).

security.name: Encryption
security.value: No specific encryption protocols detailed in public documentation. Policy states Auphonic 'takes all measures reasonably necessary to protect against unauthorized access.'

security.name: Two-Factor Authentication
security.value: Optional 2FA available; added September 2025. Helps ensure only trusted people can access projects and connected services.

security.name: Data Retention - Billing Metadata
security.value: Retained indefinitely in internal accounting systems.

security.name: Data Retention - Algorithm Training Data
security.value: Selected audio/video excerpts may be stored indefinitely for algorithm improvement.

security.name: Backup Policy
security.value: Auphonic explicitly states it is NOT a data storage or backup service and does not backup customer content.

security.name: Third-Party Data Sharing
security.value: Content not shared with third parties without explicit permission. Only aggregated statistical data disclosed.

products.name: Auphonic Web Platform
products.data_scope: Audio and video files, metadata, production settings, user-generated content
products.notes: Main product serving podcasters, educators, content creators, and broadcasters. Includes noise reduction, leveling, filtering, speech-to-text, multitrack processing.

products.name: Auphonic API
products.data_scope: Same as web platform plus authentication tokens for external service integrations
products.notes: Programmatic access for developers; supports productions creation, management, and automation.

products.name: Auphonic CLI
products.notes: Command-line interface launched March 2026 for integration into workflows. Local processing with remote uploads.

products.name: White-Label API
products.data_scope: Custom algorithms, custom pricing, embedded in third-party products
products.notes: Allows direct integration into digital audio workstations, content distribution platforms, and other audio products.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (2 hours/month free) plus paid tier subscriptions with monthly hour allowances
compare.data_residency: Germany-based (Hetzner); EU-restricted for EU users. No self-hosting available.

flags: No formal security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) despite 13 years in operation and 2M+ user base. Indicates growth-stage maturity without enterprise-grade compliance infrastructure.
Customer content used for algorithm improvement with employee access. No opt-out mechanism documented. May be concern for sensitive audio content or proprietary training material.
Security practices described only in vague terms ('all measures reasonably necessary'). No detail on encryption standards, key management, or intrusion detection.
Aggressive data deletion (7-21 days) means this is NOT suitable as a backup service or for long-term archival.
Service explicitly disclaims liability for 'loss or corruption of data.' Combined with no backup policy, customers should not rely on Auphonic as their only copy of content.
DPA only offered to paying customers 'on request', not automated or guaranteed, potentially limiting use by enterprises processing third-party personal data.
